steps.en: Install and run onboarding on your machine
steps.zh: 在本机安装并跑完引导

steps.en: Starts the server and dashboard with an embedded Postgres
steps.zh: 启动服务和看板，自带内嵌 Postgres

component.zh: Node 服务 + React 看板

steps.en: Create a company goal, hire a CEO agent and pick its adapter
steps.zh: 建公司目标，雇一个 CEO agent 并选适配器

steps.en: Wakes the CEO on a heartbeat; it drafts a strategy for your approval
steps.zh: 按心跳唤醒 CEO，它起草战略交你审批

steps.en: Approve the strategy and set monthly budgets per agent
steps.zh: 批准战略，给每个 agent 设月度预算

steps.en: CEO splits work into tickets; each agent checks one out atomically and runs
steps.zh: CEO 拆成工单，每个 agent 原子领取一张再开工

steps.en: Logs every run and its cost; pauses any agent that hits its budget
steps.zh: 记下每次运行和花费，超预算的 agent 自动暂停

value.en: Many agents work a shared goal without double work, lost context or runaway spend — you manage from one dashboard
value.zh: 多个 agent 围绕同一目标干活，不重复、不丢上下文、不失控烧钱，你只在一个看板上管

sources: https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip README Quickstart (npx paperclipai onboard --yes; API server at http://localhost:3100; embedded PostgreSQL)
docs/start/quickstart.md What's Next (create company, define goal, create CEO agent and configure its adapter, set budgets, assign tasks)
docs/start/core-concepts.md (CEO drafts strategy for approval, breaks goals into tasks; atomic checkout with 409 Conflict; heartbeats)
docs/agents-runtime.md (built-in adapters claude_local / codex_local; heartbeat wake triggers; session resume)
skills/paperclip/SKILL.md (injected PAPERCLIP_* env vars and run JWT; agents call the REST API under /api)
README Budget & Cost Control (overspend pauses agents and cancels queued work)
